items.name: base
items.title: zyx Base
items.description: The zyx.tw design system base: a terminal look in one monospace face, grayscale tokens, four type sizes, square corners and two motion durations.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Starting any project on the zyx.tw look: tokens, fonts, type sizes, motion durations.
Not for: Changing a single color; edit the tokens in your own globals.css instead.
Fonts: put <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://ui.zyx.tw/fonts/maple-mono-nf-cn.css"> in the document head (index.html, or <head> in the root layout). A CSS @import of it after Tailwind is dropped.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/index.md

meta.useWhen: Starting any project on the zyx.tw look: tokens, fonts, type sizes, motion durations.
meta.notFor: Changing a single color; edit the tokens in your own globals.css instead.

theme.font-sans: var(--font-maple-mono, Maple Mono NF CN), var(--font-noto-sans-tc), ui-monospace, monospace

theme.font-mono: var(--font-maple-mono, Maple Mono NF CN), var(--font-noto-sans-tc), ui-monospace, monospace

items.name: agent-telemetry
items.title: Agent Telemetry
items.description: OTLP tracing for agent apps: registerTelemetry for instrumentation.ts, inSpan, and a traced fetch for model calls that records the upstream provider. Off until OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set; spans never carry content.

Use when: Tracing an agent app's requests and model calls over OTLP.
Not for: Logging prompts or outputs; spans never carry content.

meta.useWhen: Tracing an agent app's requests and model calls over OTLP.
meta.notFor: Logging prompts or outputs; spans never carry content.

items.name: agent-seal
items.title: Agent Seal
items.description: AES-256-GCM sealing for credentials an agent uses but never sees, and redact to scrub their values (and their JSON and URL forms) from anything returned.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Storing credentials an agent uses but must never see, and scrubbing them from output.
Not for: Hashing passwords; use a password hash for those.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/index.md

meta.useWhen: Storing credentials an agent uses but must never see, and scrubbing them from output.
meta.notFor: Hashing passwords; use a password hash for those.

items.name: agent-public-fetch
items.title: Agent Public Fetch
items.description: fetch for requests made on an agent's behalf that reaches public addresses only, checked inside the connection's own DNS lookup so DNS rebinding cannot slip through. Node.js only.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Fetching a URL a person or a model supplied, server side.
Not for: Calling your own internal services; it blocks private addresses on purpose.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/index.md

meta.useWhen: Fetching a URL a person or a model supplied, server side.
meta.notFor: Calling your own internal services; it blocks private addresses on purpose.

items.name: page-decode
items.title: Page Decode
items.description: The page motion: a page's text decodes in row by row as a terminal prints it, and scrambles out before a link within the app leaves it. No framework needed.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Mounting once in the root layout so every page decodes in and scrambles out.
Not for: Animating one element after load; use scramble-text. In Next.js mount page-decode-next.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/page-decode.md

meta.useWhen: Mounting once in the root layout so every page decodes in and scrambles out.
meta.notFor: Animating one element after load; use scramble-text. In Next.js mount page-decode-next.

items.name: page-decode-next
items.title: Page Decode for Next.js
items.description: PageDecode on the Next.js App Router: it follows the router's path and leaves through router.push, so links stay client side.

items.docs:
Use when: Mounting the page motion once in a Next.js root layout.
Not for: Vite or other React apps; mount page-decode there.

meta.useWhen: Mounting the page motion once in a Next.js root layout.
meta.notFor: Vite or other React apps; mount page-decode there.

items.description: Range slider with a 4px track and 20px thumbs.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Choosing a number in a range where the exact value matters little.
Not for: Exact numbers; use input.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/slider.md

meta.useWhen: Choosing a number in a range where the exact value matters little.
meta.notFor: Exact numbers; use input.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toasts in a small window.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Telling the outcome of an action in a few words: saved, failed.
Not for: Information the person must act on; put it on the page.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/sonner.md

meta.useWhen: Telling the outcome of an action in a few words: saved, failed.
meta.notFor: Information the person must act on; put it on the page.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On / off toggle, one size.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: A setting that applies at once: on or off.
Not for: Choices submitted with a form; use checkbox.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/switch.md

meta.useWhen: A setting that applies at once: on or off.
meta.notFor: Choices submitted with a form; use checkbox.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table with muted headers.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Rows of records people scan and compare.
Not for: Layout; use the grid.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/table.md

meta.useWhen: Rows of records people scan and compare.
meta.notFor: Layout; use the grid.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented tabs with 40px triggers.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Switching between a few views of the same thing.
Not for: Navigation between pages; use the corner nav.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/tabs.md

meta.useWhen: Switching between a few views of the same thing.
meta.notFor: Navigation between pages; use the corner nav.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line input that grows with its content.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Several lines of text that grow as people type.
Not for: One line; use input.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/textarea.md

meta.useWhen: Several lines of text that grow as people type.
meta.notFor: One line; use input.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Icon button that switches light and dark (next-themes).
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Letting people switch light and dark.
Not for: Sites that are dark only.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/theme-toggle.md

meta.useWhen: Letting people switch light and dark.
meta.notFor: Sites that are dark only.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Pressable button that stays on, the box of a ghost Button.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: A button that stays on, such as bold or a view mode.
Not for: Settings; use switch.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/toggle.md

meta.useWhen: A button that stays on, such as bold or a view mode.
meta.notFor: Settings; use switch.

items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Floating window of 40px controls over a canvas or map.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: Floating controls over a canvas or a map.
Not for: Page actions; put buttons in the page.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/toolbar.md

meta.useWhen: Floating controls over a canvas or a map.
meta.notFor: Page actions; put buttons in the page.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short lowercase label in a small window on hover or focus.
items.author: zyx1121 (https://github.com/zyx1121)
items.docs:
Use when: A short lowercase label for an icon or a corner link.
Not for: Content people need to read; put it on the page.
Guide: https://ui.zyx.tw/tooltip.md

meta.useWhen: A short lowercase label for an icon or a corner link.
meta.notFor: Content people need to read; put it on the page.
